extractionQuery: SELECT p.id, p.signal_id, p.symbol, p.side, p.strategy_family, p.strategy_version, p.entry_time, p.entry_price, p.entry_fill_price, p.stop_price, p.take_profit_price, p.max_hold_until, p.quantity, p.theoretical_risk_usdt, p.exit_time, p.exit_price, p.exit_reason, p.r_multiple, p.net_pnl_usdt, p.fees_usdt, p.funding_usdt, p.slippage_usdt, p.metadata, s.id, s.source_data_timestamp, s.score, s.score_components, s.market_regime, s.side, s.strategy_family, s.primary_timeframe, s.confirmation_timeframes, s.regime_dependency, s.entry_price, s.stop_price, s.take_profit_price, s.valid_until FROM public.bca_paper_trades p LEFT JOIN public.bca_signals s ON s.id = p.signal_id WHERE p.strategy_version = 'trend-rejection-short-v1' AND p.exit_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.entry_time ASC
